title: One-time Specialized Academic Council PhD (Oliinyk E.V.)

blocks.content: Educational and Scientific Program: Materials Science and Metal Processing
Scientific Supervisor: Acting Deputy Director for Scientific Work of the Iron and Steel Institute of the NAS of Ukraine, Doctor of Technical Sciences, Senior Researcher Eduard PARUSOV
Dissertation Topic: Features of the formation of structure and properties of rolled products of increased deformability from low-carbon Cr-Mo-V steels for the manufacture of welding wire
Order No.__ dated 27.07.2026 'On the Establishment of a One-time Specialized Academic Council for Awarding the Degree of Doctor of Philosophy'

Chairman of the One-time Council – Prykhodko Ihor Yuriiovych, Doctor of Technical Sciences, Senior Researcher, Head of the Department of Processes and Machines for Pressure Metalworking of the Z.I. Nekrasov Iron and Steel Institute of the NAS of Ukraine.

Official Opponent – Kostin Valerii Anatoliiovych, Doctor of Technical Sciences, Senior Researcher, Leading Researcher of the Department of Physicochemical Research of Materials of the E.O. Paton Electric Welding Institute of the NAS of Ukraine.

Official Opponent — Beketov Oleksandr Vadymovych, Doctor of Technical Sciences, Associate Professor, Dean of the Faculty of Information Technologies and Mechanical Engineering of the Prydniprovska State Academy of Civil Engineering and Architecture of the Ukrainian State University of Science and Technologies of the Ministry of Education and Science of Ukraine.

Reviewer – Lutsenko Vladyslav Anatoliiovych, Doctor of Technical Sciences, Senior Researcher, Leading Researcher of the Department of Heat Treatment of Metal for Mechanical Engineering of the Z.I. Nekrasov Iron and Steel Institute of the NAS of Ukraine.

Reviewer – Razdobrieiev Valerii Huriiovych, Candidate of Technical Sciences, Senior Researcher of the Department of Processes and Machines for Pressure Metalworking of the Z.I. Nekrasov Iron and Steel Institute of the NAS of Ukraine.
Date and Time of Defense: April 1, 2025, starting at 10:00.
Place of Defense: Dnipro, Academician Starodubov Square, 1, Room 314.
